data_status.actionable_reason: deployed model is unvalidated; output is research context only

ranking_inputs: completed-daily-bar technical score within currency and asset class
model_status.scenario_status: unvalidated heuristic range; not a probability or expected return

legacy_keys.rankings_by_asset: deprecated and empty; cross-currency global ordering is disabled

model_status.fundamental_status: descriptive only; excluded from overall cross-sectional ranking because robust sector-neutral point-in-time peer ranks are not implemented
model_status.cross_currency_status: disabled: no point-in-time historical FX; no shared global ordering

analyst: analyst count, consensus, target and target gap
potential: analyst context and unvalidated scenario ranges
risk: downside structure, volatility, earnings, distress and knife flags
thesis: complete fundamentals when available, trend, analysts and news
research: timing, trend, valuation, analyst, risk and news contexts
overall: all insight groups; core ranking remains unchanged
knife: 5d/20d deterioration, fast averages, MACD and daily direction
trend: Weinstein stage, RSI, SMA50, MACD and earnings proximity
zone: nearest support, ATR and current price

undervalued_quality.label: Unterbewertete Qualität
undervalued_quality.formula: 55% value + 45% quality; current complete company fundamentals only; generic banks/insurers/REITs excluded

analyst_potential.label: Analysten-Potenzial
analyst_potential.formula: 55% normalized analyst target gap + 25% trend + 20% timing, minus visible overbought/weak-trend penalties; >=5 analysts

entry_watchlist.label: Timing-Beobachtung
entry_watchlist.formula: 65% entry timing + 35% trend; no negative daily context, falling knife or high downside structure
